history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration review the cost-recovery accumulated surplus of UNMISS, UNSOS, MINUSMA, MINUSCA, MONUSCO and UNISFA and make the necessary adjustments.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. As highlighted in table 8 of the report of the Secretary- General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (A/80/369), reclassification of prior-year revenue from spendable to non-spendable, followed by its return to Member States, was completed, including for UNMISS, UNSOS, MINUSMA, MINUSCA, MONUSCO and UNISFA. The returns were based on a comprehensive review of prior-year revenue in peacekeeping missions from 2014/15 to 2022/23.
history.board_assessment: The Board takes note of efforts made regarding classification between spendable and non- spendable revenue. However, given that the surplus has increased compared with the previous fiscal year, the recommendation is considered under implementation.
